about.title: About EduBridge
about.subtitle: A platform designed to simplify access to higher education in Tunisia
about.description1: EduBridge is a Tunisian digital platform dedicated to connecting candidates with private higher education institutions in Tunisia. It covers all programs: preparatory cycles, bachelor's degrees, engineering cycles and master's degrees in fields as varied as computer science, civil engineering, electrical, mechanical and many others.
about.description2: Candidates can explore available programs, compare institutions and submit their applications online. Institutions have a dedicated space to manage admissions and communicate directly with candidates.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Democratize access to higher education information and reduce orientation inequalities in Tunisia.

partners.title: Our partners
partners.text: We collaborate with accredited public and private institutions, selected for the quality of their programs and their commitment to students.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Candidates' personal data is protected and shared only with the relevant institutions, in strict compliance with privacy standards.

hero.title: Your complete guide to studying in Tunisia
hero.subtitle: From your first administrative steps to campus integration, find all the practical answers to prepare calmly for your arrival.

visa.title: Visa & residence permit
visa.description: Understanding the administrative procedures to legally enter and reside in Tunisia as a foreign student.
visa.delayDescription: Allow 6 to 10 weeks between starting your file and obtaining your residence permit. Start your application as soon as you receive your admission.
visa.eduBridgeAttestation: Your EduBridge enrollment certificate can serve as proof of admission at the Tunisian embassy in your country.

financing.title: Finance your studies
financing.description: Several financing options are available to foreign students, from government programs to partner institute scholarships.

life.title: Living in Tunisia
life.description: A manageable cost of living, several housing options and an accessible healthcare system for students.
life.healthCnam: The CNAM (National Health Insurance Fund) is only open to Tunisian students and permanent residents.
life.healthMutual: Several student mutual funds offer accessible annual packages (200 to 400 TND/year).
life.healthWarning: You must take out an international insurance covering hospitalization and repatriation before departure.

admissionProcess.title: Admission process
admissionProcess.description: Five structured steps to apply, submit your official documents and finalize your enrollment in a Tunisian institute.

equivalenceSection.title: Diploma recognition
equivalenceSection.description: The equivalency of your foreign diploma is a mandatory step to join a Tunisian program. Here's how to proceed depending on your country of origin.
equivalenceSection.cneqDescription: The National Center for the Evaluation of Qualifications (CNEQ) is the official body responsible for evaluating foreign diplomas and issuing equivalency certificates. Any enrollment in a Tunisian institute above the baccalaureate level goes through it.

documentChecklist.title: Document checklist
documentChecklist.description: Check items as you gather your documents. The generated copy will accompany you on your journey.

safety.title: Safety & emergencies
safety.description: Essential numbers and best practices for a peaceful stay. Save them before you even leave.

cultureIntegration.title: Cultural integration
cultureIntegration.description: Tunisia is a welcoming and diverse country. Some guidelines to experience your integration with confidence and respect.
cultureIntegration.closingMessage: You arrive with your own history and culture, and Tunisia welcomes you with its own. Be curious, ask questions, accept invitations: it is through human contact that the most precious memories of a stay abroad are made.

contactSection.title: A team dedicated to your arrival
contactSection.description: Our international student unit supports you, from the first email to your effective installation on campus.
